Galio.build: Since Veigar deals magic damage, consider magic penetration before adding more ability power against Galio. Prioritize tenacity so you don't get hit by Galio's taunt and airborne effects in succession; if building resistance, choose magic resistance over armor.
Galio.combo: Cast Veigar E Event Horizon behind Galio to block his escape route. If he is stunned after crossing its edge, drop Veigar W Dark Matter. Then hit him with Veigar Q Baleful Strike and finish Galio with Veigar R Primordial Burst once his health has been reduced.
Galio.escape: Engage after Galio E Justice Punch and R Hero's Entrance are both down, and after you have dodged the taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand. In particular, before Galio R Hero's Entrance returns, block his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and look for a chance to secure a kill.
Galio.fight: When Galio approaches for a melee attack, keep your distance and build harassment stacks with Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Hold your damage while Galio charges W Shield of Durand; after dodging the taunt, start a trade by blocking his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon.
Galio.laning: Early on, keep the lane in the middle, last-hit cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and hit Galio with Q when he is in range to build stacks. If Galio spends mana clearing the wave with his abilities, push the lane to limit his chance to influence other lanes with Galio R Hero's Entrance. If Veigar's mana is below half, stop harassing and focus on farming.
Galio.phase: Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power stacks keep building in the late game, making the matchup favorable for Veigar.
Galio.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off Galio's entry route, and move out of range if you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance. If an opponent is trapped or caught by crowd control, hit them with Veigar W Dark Matter and Q Baleful Strike. Save Veigar R Primordial Burst for a target who must be killed, such as an enemy damage dealer whose health has been reduced.
Galio.watch: Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see its preparatory motion as he steps back, and cast Veigar E Event Horizon in advance on his entry route. When Galio charges W Shield of Durand, don't unload your damage; move outside taunt range. If you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance, immediately walk out of its area.

Anivia.fight: If Anivia Q Flash Frost catches you, Anivia E Frostbite is likely to follow, so keep your distance first. After Anivia uses Q and Anivia W Crystallize, block her escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and attack. If Anivia P Rebirth is available, don’t try to secure the kill alone; go in with your allies.
Anivia.combo: Cast Veigar E Event Horizon over Anivia’s escape route so she has to cross its edge. If Anivia P Rebirth is available, make sure an ally is with you to deal with the egg.
Anivia.build: Anivia’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Veigar also relies on mana and ability haste, so build those afterward.
Anivia.escape: The opening to engage comes after Anivia Q Flash Frost and Anivia W Crystallize are down. Anivia has no mobility, so once you close the distance, block her escape with Veigar E Event Horizon.
Anivia.laning: Last-hit cannon minions with Q whenever possible. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Anivia.phase: In the late game, Veigar’s stacks continue to grow, so the more you focus on scaling, the better.
Anivia.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to block the enemy’s approach or escape. Since Anivia W Crystallize can cut off an escape through a narrow passage, start fights on a wide lane. If an enemy is trapped or crowd controlled by your team, hit them with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and use Veigar R Primordial Burst on a priority target whose health has been reduced.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost can detonate while traveling and stun you, so look for a chance to dodge from outside its range. If you are hit by Q or chilled inside Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so leave the storm immediately. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape.

Akshan.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off Akshan’s approach, then hit the trapped enemy with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst to finish off a priority damage dealer who has lost health. If Akshan W Going Rogue marks you as a Scoundrel, avoid facing Akshan alone and fight outside his finishing range.
Akshan.build: Akshan’s main damage is physical, and Veigar has low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If Akshan keeps diving onto Veigar, move Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier in your core build.
Akshan.combo: When Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, cast Veigar E Event Horizon over Akshan’s escape route so he has to cross its edge. Then drop Veigar W Dark Matter where he is trapped and hit him with Veigar Q Baleful Strike.
Akshan.escape: Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is down is your window to look for a kill. Use Veigar E Event Horizon to block his escape, but save it to protect yourself if there is a high risk of Akshan diving back in.
Akshan.fight: Avoid extended fights early. When Akshan comes into range, hit him with Veigar Q Baleful Strike to build stacks. After you force Akshan to use Akshan E Heroic Swing, block his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and fight. If Veigar E Event Horizon is down, watch for Akshan to dive back in.
Akshan.laning: Keep the wave in the middle instead of pushing it all the way, and use Veigar Q Baleful Strike to farm and build poke stacks. Akshan Q Avengerang gains range as it hits minions, so don’t rely on standing behind minions to dodge it. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Akshan.phase: The more Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power stacks Veigar gains, the stronger he gets, so the matchup favors Veigar more as the game goes on.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so dodge its outbound and return paths even from behind minions. Place Veigar E Event Horizon ahead of time where Akshan can swing in along a wall with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If Akshan R Comeuppance targets you while your health is low, get behind terrain.

AurelionSol.laning: Don’t push the wave all the way. From the middle, use Veigar Q Baleful Strike on cannon minions and enemy champions to build growth stacks. Poke from behind minions and move out of the aim line so Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light doesn’t hit you for free and grant him Stardust. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming; only move forward when you know where the enemy jungler is.
AurelionSol.build: Aurelion Sol’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on max health, so don’t rely on a large health increase alone; also consider movement speed to leave telegraphed attack areas and enough health to stay above Aurelion Sol E Singularity’s execution threshold.
AurelionSol.combo: When Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, place Veigar E Event Horizon behind his escape route so he has to cross its edge. Then drop Veigar W Dark Matter where he is trapped and hit him with Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Once health has been reduced, finish him with Veigar R Primordial Burst.
AurelionSol.escape: Right after you have forced Aurelion Sol to expend W Astral Flight is your window to close the distance and engage. Use Veigar E Event Horizon to block his escape, but save it for defense when you need to stop him from engaging. Don’t enter a spot telegraphed for Aurelion Sol E Singularity or the crowd control from Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.fight: While Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is available, keep your distance and be ready to use Veigar E Event Horizon on his approach path. Right after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, block his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon, then hit him with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike where he is trapped.
AurelionSol.phase: Both champions are weak early, but Veigar is also vulnerable to pressure because he lacks stacks and mobility, so focus on scaling without taking losses. Both sides grow stronger with permanent stacks later, so don’t assume either one is stronger; avoid giving Aurelion Sol Stardust and fight from a safe distance.
AurelionSol.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight’s approach or block the enemy’s escape. If an enemy is trapped or crowd controlled, follow up with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst to finish off a priority target whose health has been reduced. Use Veigar E Event Horizon in narrow paths, but keep your distance from allies so several of you aren’t hit by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on max health and contributes to his Stardust growth, so stand behind minions and quickly move out of its aim line. If caught by Aurelion Sol E Singularity, immediately walk out; when your health is low, stay away from even the edge to avoid its execute. Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend slow and stun, and after he has built up Stardust they also add a knockup and area shockwave, so keep your distance from allies.

Hwei.escape: Go in right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used. Hwei has no mobility, so blocking their escape with Veigar E Event Horizon at this moment makes it hard for them to create distance. Veigar E Event Horizon is your only survival tool, so hold it for defense if the enemy threatens to engage.
Hwei.build: Veigar depends heavily on mana and ability haste, so prioritize those. Build magic resistance against Hwei’s magic damage, and account for Hwei Q Subject: Disaster’s damage based on your maximum health before choosing an item that adds a lot of health alone. Also consider movement speed to leave telegraphed attack areas and tenacity in case Hwei E Subject: Torment catches you.
Hwei.combo: Place Veigar E Event Horizon behind Hwei on their escape route so they are stunned if they touch its edge.
Hwei.fight: The moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear is your chance to close the gap. Place Veigar E Event Horizon on Hwei’s escape route to pressure them into touching its edge. If they’re stunned, deal damage with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Don’t step forward while Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available.
Hwei.laning: Early on, keep the wave in the middle and stack with Veigar Q Baleful Strike by last-hitting cannon minions. When Hwei comes within range, hit them with Veigar Q Baleful Strike to scale, but reposition to break the combo if you’re hit by Hwei’s first spell. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Hwei.phase: In the late game, your stacks put Veigar in a strong position, so focus on wave management and scaling instead of risky roams.
Hwei.teamfight: From behind your team, use Veigar E Event Horizon to block Hwei’s approach or escape route. When Hwei E Subject: Torment is down or Hwei is crowd controlled, hit them with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Save Veigar R Primordial Burst to finish off a key damage dealer whose health has been reduced.
Hwei.watch: Hwei E Subject: Torment can set you up to take follow-up attacks if its root or displacement catches you. If you’re hit by the first spell, move immediately to avoid the second spell and the Hwei P Signature of the Visionary explosion. Watch for follow-up attacks when slowed by Hwei R Spiraling Despair, too.

Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so avoid giving her a chance to get a kill, build armor, and move with your team. Veigar gains the advantage in the late game as his stacks build.
Qiyana.build: Qiyana's main damage is physical and Veigar has low armor, so build Cloth Armor first. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots, and move Zhonya's Hourglass earlier in your core build to prepare for an engage after Veigar E Event Horizon is down.
Qiyana.combo: Before Qiyana E Audacity comes back up, place Veigar E Event Horizon to block her escape route. Then drop Veigar W Dark Matter where she is trapped and hit her with Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst last, after health has been reduced.
Qiyana.escape: Do not rush to engage when only Qiyana W Terrashape is down, since she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity. After she has used both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity, block her escape with Veigar E Event Horizon, especially before Qiyana E Audacity comes back up. Look for the moment when the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal is also down.
Qiyana.fight: If Qiyana closes in on Veigar, she can easily follow up with attacks, so keep your distance and prepare Veigar E Event Horizon across her approach. When she has used Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity and remains in front of you, counterattack with Veigar Q Baleful Strike.
Qiyana.laning: Early on, keep the lane near the middle instead of fully pushing it, and build poke stacks with Veigar Q Baleful Strike when Qiyana comes into range. Finish cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike to scale, and when your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming. Do not step forward until you know where the enemy jungler is.
Qiyana.teamfight: From behind your allies, cut off Qiyana's approach with Veigar E Event Horizon, and follow up with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike if she is trapped or caught by allied crowd control. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst to finish a weakened key damage dealer. Keep Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent in mind: avoid fighting by the river or in narrow passages, and stand away from walls.
Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal helps her engage with a root or stealth depending on the element. If she approaches with the river element, move outside the root's range; if she disappears with the brush element, move into your allies' vision. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes on hitting a wall and stuns, so do not stand with your back to a wall.

Yone.laning: Use Q Baleful Strike to last-hit cannon minions whenever possible. If your mana drops below half, stop trading and farm. Even though Yone is weak early, don’t walk up to pressure him when the tornado from his Q Mortal Steel is ready.
Yone.build: Against an opponent like Yone who dives in targeting Veigar, move Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier in your purchase order to have a defensive option when Veigar E Event Horizon is down. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so don’t focus on only one type of resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Yone.combo: After Yone engages, place Veigar E Event Horizon in his path or across his escape route to make him step on its edge. If Yone is in Yone E Soul Unbound, Veigar E Event Horizon’s stun can also prevent him from returning to his body.
Yone.escape: Don’t engage just because Yone Q Mortal Steel is down; check whether Yone E Soul Unbound and R Fate Sealed are still available. In particular, look to hit a Yone who has used his engage with Veigar E Event Horizon before Yone R Fate Sealed is ready again.
Yone.fight: When Yone has his tornado Q Mortal Steel ready, create distance first. Build stacks by hitting him with Veigar Q Baleful Strike when he comes within range. If he dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, place Veigar E Event Horizon in his path to try to stun him. Veigar E Event Horizon is your only survival tool, so even when using it offensively, check whether you can handle another engage afterward.
Yone.phase: In the late game, Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power stacks keep building, so manage the waves and continue scaling.
Yone.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off Yone’s approach, then hit a trapped or stunned Yone with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Spread out from your allies because Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield grows when it hits multiple champions, and watch your formation so you aren’t the last target hit by Yone R Fate Sealed. Save Veigar R Primordial Burst for a key target whose health has been reduced.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, keep your distance until the stacks disappear. If he dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, he can deal additional damage when he returns, so move out of range before health drops. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies it hits and moves him behind the last champion hit, so don’t be the only one standing far behind in teamfights.

Ahri.build: Build magic resistance first against Ahri’s main damage. However, magic resistance does not reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return, so consider your total health too. Before prioritizing items, keep a position that lets you dodge Ahri E Charm.
Ahri.combo: Place Veigar E Event Horizon across Ahri’s escape route to pressure her into crossing its edge. Then drop Veigar W Dark Matter where she is trapped and hit her with Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Finish off Ahri after her health has been reduced with Veigar R Primordial Burst.
Ahri.escape: If Ahri E Charm has also been used, use Veigar E Event Horizon to block Ahri’s way out and fight her.
Ahri.fight: Don’t force fights early. When Ahri comes into range, hit her with Veigar Q Baleful Strike to stack Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power. When Ahri E Charm is down and she has no Ahri R Spirit Rush, use Veigar E Event Horizon to block her escape and look for a kill.
Ahri.laning: Dodge Ahri E Charm by keeping a minion wave between you and her, while using Veigar Q Baleful Strike to last-hit cannon minions and build poke stacks. Keep the wave in the middle. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Ahri.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off Ahri’s approach or block her escape. If she is trapped or crowd controlled, hit her with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Save Veigar R Primordial Burst for a priority target whose health has been reduced.
Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, she can follow up with a combo, so dodge with a minion between you. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on its return, so after dodging the first pass, move out of its return path.

Akali.build: If Akali is diving onto Veigar, move Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier in your core build. Get magic resistance and health against Akali’s magic damage. Since Akali takes little magic damage, include penetration as well.
Akali.combo: Cast Veigar E Event Horizon over Akali’s escape route so she has to cross its edge to leave.
Akali.escape: If only one of Akali W Twilight Shroud and E Shuriken Flip is down, keep her remaining mobility in mind. When you engage, place Veigar E Event Horizon across Akali’s escape route.
Akali.fight: Place Veigar E Event Horizon in Akali’s path as she approaches, then damage her with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike when she catches its edge.
Akali.laning: When Akali comes into range, hit her with Veigar Q Baleful Strike to build stacks, and use Q to last-hit cannon minions too. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Akali.phase: In the late game, keep managing waves and scaling as Veigar’s stacks continue to grow.
Akali.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off Akali’s approach. If she is trapped or crowd controlled by your team, hit her with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst to finish off a priority enemy whose health has been reduced.
Akali.watch: Once marked, the second dash will follow you even if you try to escape.

Annie.build: Veigar has no mobility, so you can prioritize tenacity to prepare for being caught by Annie P Pyromania and hit by her full combo. Then build magic resistance to withstand Annie’s magic damage. Annie R Summon: Tibbers has penetration, so don’t rely on resistance alone to absorb the damage.
Annie.combo: Place Veigar E Event Horizon along Annie’s retreat path to make her cross its edge. After her health is chipped down, finish her with Veigar R Primordial Burst.
Annie.escape: Right after Annie has spent the stun from Annie P Pyromania is your chance to engage. Annie has no mobility, so blocking her escape with Veigar E Event Horizon makes it hard for her to get away. Don’t engage while the stun is ready.
Annie.fight: While Annie P Pyromania is ready, keep your distance and look for a safe chance to hit her with Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Once the stun is used, block Annie’s escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and attack.
Annie.laning: Early on, don’t push the wave all the way; keep it in the middle and use Veigar Q Baleful Strike to kill minions and hit Annie for stacks. When Annie P Pyromania is ready, back off and poke after she uses it. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Annie.phase: The more Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power stacks Veigar gains, the more the matchup favors him in the late game.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie P Pyromania is ready or Annie is missing, avoid clustering with your allies to watch for the area stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers. From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to block Annie’s approach or escape, then hit her with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike when she is trapped. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst on an important target whose health has been reduced.
Annie.watch: When Annie P Pyromania is ready to stun, stay out of her ability range. Annie R Summon: Tibbers deals area damage and has penetration, so keep your distance to avoid being hit alongside several allies. Don’t stay near Tibbers even after killing Annie.

Aurora.build: Build magic resistance first against Aurora's main damage. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health. If the enemy has another assassin who will dive Veigar, move Zhonya's Hourglass earlier in your core build.
Aurora.combo: After Aurora's mobility spell is down, cast Veigar E Event Horizon behind her on her escape route so she has to cross its edge. Then drop Veigar W Dark Matter where she is trapped and hit her with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, finishing her with Veigar R Primordial Burst once health has been reduced.
Aurora.escape: Don't engage just because Aurora W Across the Veil is down; check whether she has also used E The Weirding. The window to engage with Veigar E Event Horizon is when Aurora R Between Worlds has not returned yet and she cannot chain her mobility spells.
Aurora.fight: Early on, build harassment stacks with Veigar Q Baleful Strike instead of forcing trades. If Aurora W Across the Veil and E The Weirding are down, and Aurora R Between Worlds has not returned yet, block her escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and fight. If you are hit by Aurora Q Twofold Hex while your health has been reduced, retreat instead of continuing the trade.
Aurora.laning: Save Veigar E Event Horizon to stop Aurora from engaging, and only move forward when the enemy jungler's position is known. If your mana drops below half, stop harassing and focus on farming.
Aurora.phase: The later the game goes, the more favorable it becomes for Veigar as he builds stacks.
Aurora.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off Aurora's entry route or block her escape. If Aurora used a mobility spell to engage and no one was killed, hit her with Veigar W Dark Matter and Q Baleful Strike where she is trapped. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst to finish a key damage dealer whose health has been reduced, and don't leave low-health allies behind when retreating.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when it returns, and that damage increases the more health the target has lost. If you are cursed, move off the straight line between Aurora and yourself; when your health is low, retreat before it returns. If Aurora disappears with W Across the Veil, hold Veigar R Primordial Burst until she reappears.

Azir.build: Build mana and ability haste first so you can keep farming and using Veigar E Event Horizon. Against Azir’s damage, build magic resistance rather than armor.
Azir.combo: When Azir E Shifting Sands is down, place Veigar E Event Horizon behind his escape route to pressure him into crossing its edge.
Azir.escape: Right after you make Azir use Azir E Shifting Sands is your chance to engage. If Azir R Emperor’s Divide is still available, he can push you back, so wait until it is down before using Veigar E Event Horizon to block his escape.
Azir.fight: When the soldiers are stationary or Azir Q Conquering Sands is down, move beside a soldier for a short trade. Right after Azir uses Azir E Shifting Sands, block his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and concentrate your damage in one burst.
Azir.laning: Early on, don’t push the wave all the way. Use Veigar Q Baleful Strike to last-hit cannon minions and build stacks. When Azir comes into range, hit him with Veigar Q Baleful Strike for stacks, but if your mana is below half, stop poking and farm.
Azir.phase: Azir also gets stronger as the game goes on, so don’t let fights drag out.
Azir.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to block Azir’s approach or escape. In narrow terrain, control the passage with Veigar E Event Horizon, but don’t bunch up so your allies aren’t all pushed back by Azir R Emperor’s Divide. If Azir is trapped, hit him with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike, then finish him with Veigar R Primordial Burst once health has been reduced.
Azir.watch: Move out of the straight line where Azir W Arise! soldiers are standing, and watch for Azir Q Conquering Sands to move his soldiers and slow you. In narrow passages, keep your distance so several allies aren’t all pushed back by Azir R Emperor’s Divide.

Corki.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Corki's main damage is physical, so build armor first. However, Corki P Hextech Munitions deals true damage that resistances can't block, so move out of Corki E Gatling Gun's range before building more resistance.
Corki.combo: Once Corki W Valkyrie is down, cast Veigar E Event Horizon on his escape route behind him so he has to cross its edge. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst to finish him after earlier damage has reduced his health.
Corki.escape: The moment after Corki W Valkyrie is down is Veigar's window to engage. Use Veigar E Event Horizon to block Corki's escape route. Veigar E Event Horizon is also his only survival tool, so don't use it to attack first when you need it to block Corki's entry route.
Corki.fight: Don't force an engage while Corki W Valkyrie is available. Right after Corki uses W Valkyrie, cast Veigar E Event Horizon across his escape route and look for an angle to stun him as he crosses its edge.
Corki.laning: Last-hit cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and hit Corki with it when he comes within safe range to build stacks. If your mana drops below half, stop harassing and focus on farming.
Corki.phase: Veigar keeps growing stronger as his stacks build in the late game, but Corki also gets stronger as he builds items, so don't let him farm freely.
Corki.teamfight: Stand behind your allies and use Veigar E Event Horizon to block Corki's entry route or escape. If Corki is trapped or caught by your allies' crowd control, hit him with Veigar W Dark Matter and Q Baleful Strike. Save Veigar R Primordial Burst for an enemy who must be killed, such as Corki after his health has been reduced.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages targets around the first one hit, so don't just hide behind minions; move out of range. Reposition to avoid being hit repeatedly, especially by the third missile. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces your armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of standing your ground in front of him.

Ekko.build: Against an enemy like Ekko who will dive Veigar, move Zhonya's Hourglass earlier in your core build to have a defensive option after Veigar E Event Horizon is down. Prioritize tenacity over magic resistance to prepare for being caught in Ekko W Parallel Convergence's stun and hit by his follow-up. If building resistance, choose magic resistance against Ekko's magic damage.
Ekko.combo: Cast Veigar E Event Horizon on Ekko's escape route so he has to cross its edge to get out. Drop Veigar W Dark Matter where he is stunned, then hit him with Veigar Q Baleful Strike and finish him with Veigar R Primordial Burst after health has been reduced. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, check the position of Ekko's afterimage before using this combo.
Ekko.escape: Right after Ekko closes in with E Phase Dive, his mobility spell is unavailable, giving you a chance to stun him with Veigar E Event Horizon. The window to fully engage is while Ekko R Chronobreak is down, and the fight is safer if Ekko W Parallel Convergence is down too. If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, he can escape with Ekko R Chronobreak, so don't engage hastily.
Ekko.fight: Cast Veigar E Event Horizon in advance on the path Ekko would take with E Phase Dive, then look for the moment right after he closes in, when his mobility spell is unavailable. If Veigar E Event Horizon is down, you have fewer ways to handle Ekko's engage, so don't fight aggressively. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, don't chase recklessly even if health is low.
Ekko.laning: Early on, keep the lane in the middle and use Veigar Q Baleful Strike to farm and build harassment stacks. Last-hit cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike when possible, and stop harassing if your mana drops below half. Avoid the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder and save Veigar E Event Horizon for Ekko's engage.
Ekko.phase: In the late game, Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power stacks keep building in his favor, so manage the wave and your stacks in mid lane unless you have a clear chance to secure a kill.
Ekko.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off Ekko's entry route and look for a stun right after he closes in with E Phase Dive. If Ekko is trapped or caught by your allies' crowd control, hit him with Veigar W Dark Matter and Q Baleful Strike. Save Veigar R Primordial Burst for a key target whose health has been reduced, and fight in a narrow area where Veigar E Event Horizon can block the passage when possible.
Ekko.watch: When you see the cast indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area to avoid its stun and shield. Move off the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder, and watch for him to close in with E Phase Dive. If you see Ekko's afterimage, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don't chase recklessly even if health is low.

Fizz.build: If Fizz is targeting Veigar and diving in, move Zhonya's Hourglass earlier in your core build to prepare for after Veigar E Event Horizon is down. If building resistance against Fizz's damage, choose magic resistance over armor.
Fizz.combo: After Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, cast Veigar E Event Horizon on his escape route so he has to cross its edge to get out. Then drop Veigar W Dark Matter where he is trapped and hit him with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, finishing Fizz with Veigar R Primordial Burst once his health has been reduced.
Fizz.escape: The window to engage is before Fizz E Playful / Trickster returns. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, he can use it to escape, so confirm he has used his mobility spell before blocking his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon.
Fizz.fight: Use the moment after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down as your chance to counterattack; until then, save Veigar E Event Horizon to defend against his engage. Also look to trade when Fizz misses a last hit with W Seastone Trident and it goes on cooldown.
Fizz.laning: Early on, keep the lane in the middle and build stacks safely instead of trying to win. Last-hit cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and hit Fizz with it when he comes within range to gain growth stacks. If your mana drops below half, stop harassing and focus on farming.
Fizz.phase: The later the game goes, the more favorable it becomes for Veigar as he builds stacks.
Fizz.teamfight: Stand close to your allies and make Fizz use E Playful / Trickster first, then focus him together once it is down. From behind your allies, Veigar should use E Event Horizon to cut off his entry route; if Fizz is trapped, hit him with Veigar W Dark Matter and Q Baleful Strike. Save Veigar R Primordial Burst for an important target whose health has been reduced.
Fizz.watch: Fizz Q Urchin Strike and E Playful / Trickster are mobility spells that let him reach Veigar, so cast Veigar E Event Horizon ahead of time on his entry route. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts.

Irelia.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and buy Plated Steelcaps. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Veigar has low armor, so build armor first. If the enemy team has an assassin who dives onto Veigar, move Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier in your core build.
Irelia.combo: Place Veigar E Event Horizon behind Irelia on her escape route so she has to touch its edge to get out. Veigar R Primordial Burst grows stronger based on missing health, so use it last.
Irelia.escape: Right after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge is your chance to trap and attack her with Veigar E Event Horizon. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, there’s less threat when you go in. Check your distance if there’s a minion between you and Irelia that she can kill with Q Bladesurge to dash back onto you.
Irelia.fight: Place Veigar E Event Horizon ahead of Irelia’s approach path to stop her from using Irelia Q Bladesurge to engage. Right after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge, trap her with Veigar E Event Horizon while her gap closer is down. Veigar E Event Horizon is your only survival tool, so don’t use it only for offense.
Irelia.laning: Don’t fully push the wave. Keep it in the middle, farm with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and hit Irelia with it when she comes into range to stack. Don’t leave low-health minions between you and Irelia, and back away when minions are about to die. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Irelia.teamfight: From behind your team, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off Irelia’s engage route. If Irelia is trapped or crowd controlled by an ally, hit her with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Focus Irelia first so she can’t take over the fight, and use Veigar R Primordial Burst on a key target whose health has been reduced.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close the gap, so create distance when minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet and the slow from Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait for the blades to disappear.

Karma.build: Karma's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Also build movement speed to break Karma W Focused Resolve's tether and leave the area from Karma Q Inner Flame.
Karma.combo: Cast Veigar E Event Horizon behind Karma on her escape route so she has to cross its edge.
Karma.escape: The moment after Karma W Focused Resolve is down is your chance to engage with Veigar E Event Horizon. If Karma's R Mantra-empowered E shield is active, wait until it ends. Veigar has no mobility spell, so don't close the distance first while Karma W Focused Resolve is available.
Karma.fight: Early on, keep your distance and hit Karma with Veigar Q Baleful Strike to build growth stacks. Once Karma W Focused Resolve is down and Karma E Inspire's shield has ended, block her escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and attack.
Karma.laning: Don't fully push the lane; keep it in the middle, last-hit cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and look for chances to hit Karma too. Reposition so you don't take Karma Q Inner Flame for free. If your mana drops below half, stop harassing and focus on farming.
Karma.phase: The later the game goes, the more favorable it becomes for Veigar as he builds growth stacks.
Karma.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to block Karma's and your allies' entry routes or escapes. If Karma W Focused Resolve is available, create distance first to make her use it, then attack after the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E ends.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame applies an area slow, and Karma R Mantra-empowered Q leaves an area that detonates again. If hit, immediately leave the area; otherwise, stand behind minions or out of range to reduce the chance of being hit. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects to you, create distance before the root to break the tether.

Kassadin.build: If Kassadin dives onto Veigar, move Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier in your core build. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Kassadin’s damage.
Kassadin.combo: When Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, place Veigar E Event Horizon on his escape route so he has to touch its edge. Then drop Veigar W Dark Matter where he’s trapped and hit him with Veigar Q Baleful Strike. After Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield is down and health has been reduced, finish him with Veigar R Primordial Burst.
Kassadin.escape: The window after Kassadin R Riftwalk is down is your chance to go in. If Kassadin E Force Pulse is down too, block his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon without worrying about its slow. If Kassadin uses R Riftwalk repeatedly, watch his mana bar and retaliate the moment his mobility becomes unavailable.
Kassadin.fight: Once Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, block his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and fight. If Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield is still up, delay your burst.
Kassadin.laning: Early on, last-hit cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and poke Kassadin with it when he comes into range to stack. Avoid wasting spells near Kassadin, as that speeds up the cooldown of Kassadin E Force Pulse. Don’t fully push the wave, since Veigar has no mobility and is vulnerable to ganks; pressure forward once you know where the enemy jungler is.
Kassadin.phase: Veigar’s stacks make him powerful in the late game, but Kassadin can still reach the backline, so don’t move ahead alone.
Kassadin.teamfight: From behind your team, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off Kassadin’s approach path, then hit him with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike as soon as he’s trapped. Save Veigar R Primordial Burst for a key target who has lost health. If possible, fight in narrow passages, and don’t stand alone within range of Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield absorbs magic poke, so deal damage after the shield is down. Prepare Veigar E Event Horizon along Kassadin’s approach path so you aren’t slowed by Kassadin E Force Pulse and chased down.

Leblanc.build: If LeBlanc dives onto Veigar, move Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier in your build so you can respond even after Veigar E Event Horizon is down. Build magic resistance rather than armor against LeBlanc’s damage.
Leblanc.combo: After LeBlanc W Distortion’s return expires or has already been used, place Veigar E Event Horizon to block her escape route. Then drop Veigar W Dark Matter where she’s trapped and hit her with Veigar Q Baleful Strike. After health has been reduced, finish her with Veigar R Primordial Burst.
Leblanc.escape: Right after LeBlanc uses W Distortion is Veigar’s chance to close the gap. If the time for her to return has expired or she has already used her return, block her escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and then go in.
Leblanc.fight: Keep your distance and poke LeBlanc with Veigar Q Baleful Strike to stack when she comes into range. Right after LeBlanc uses W Distortion, block her path with Veigar E Event Horizon, but it’s safer to fight after the time for her to return has expired or she has already used her return. Don’t step forward to trade while LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice’s mark is on you.
Leblanc.laning: Early on, don’t fully push the wave; keep it in the middle and use Veigar Q Baleful Strike to farm and stack through poke. Look for a chance to last-hit cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and farm. Alert your team immediately if LeBlanc disappears from mid-lane vision.
Leblanc.phase: As the game moves toward the late game and stacks build, the matchup increasingly favors Veigar, so farm the wave and stack in mid unless you have a clear chance to secure a kill.
Leblanc.teamfight: Stay behind your team and use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off LeBlanc’s approach or block the enemy’s escape. If an enemy is trapped or crowd controlled by an ally, hit them with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst to finish off a key damage dealer who has lost health.
Leblanc.watch: While LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice’s mark remains, her next spell deals heavy damage, so retreat and give the mark time to disappear. Place Veigar E Event Horizon ahead of LeBlanc W Distortion’s approach path. If you’re hit by LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, get out of the chain’s range before it roots you.

Lissandra.build: Veigar depends heavily on mana and ability haste, so prioritize those. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance and also get tenacity against her roots and stuns.
Lissandra.combo: Place Veigar E Event Horizon behind Lissandra on her escape route so she gets stunned if she tries to cross its edge. Then drop Veigar W Dark Matter where she’s trapped, hit her with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and finish her with Veigar R Primordial Burst when health has been reduced. If Lissandra puts herself into stasis with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, spread your damage out until the stasis ends.
Lissandra.escape: Right after Lissandra uses E Glacial Path is your chance to close the gap. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down too, block her escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and trade.
Lissandra.fight: Trade right after Lissandra uses W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. As Lissandra E Glacial Path travels, block its path with Veigar E Event Horizon, then hit her where she’s trapped with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike.
Lissandra.laning: Early on, don’t fully push the wave; keep it in the middle, last-hit cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and hit Lissandra with it to stack whenever she’s within range. Stand at an angle to your allied minions to avoid the piercing path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Lissandra.phase: Veigar gets stronger as his stacks build, so focus on the late game and manage the wave and your stacks.
Lissandra.teamfight: From behind your team, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off Lissandra’s approach or block her escape. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is down, she has no escape tool, so hit her with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike the moment she’s trapped or crowd controlled. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst to finish off a key enemy who has lost health.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting a minion, so don’t stand in a line with your allied minions. Lissandra W Ring of Frost roots, and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb stuns; either can set you up to take follow-up damage, so block her approach with Veigar E Event Horizon when she comes in.

Lux.build: For your first purchase, account for Veigar’s need for mana and ability haste. Build magic resistance against Lux’s damage, and get tenacity in case Lux Q Light Binding roots you and sets up follow-up attacks. Movement speed is also useful for leaving the telegraphed area of Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Lux.combo: After Lux Q Light Binding misses, place Veigar E Event Horizon behind her to block her escape. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst last, after Lux has lost health.
Lux.escape: Right after dodging Lux Q Light Binding is your chance to close the gap. Lux has no spell or mobility tool to create distance on her own, so if you get close, block her escape with Veigar E Event Horizon.
Lux.fight: Bait out and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, then close the gap. Lux has no mobility, so place Veigar E Event Horizon on her escape route to make her touch its edge. Keep hitting Lux with Veigar Q Baleful Strike to stack Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power.
Lux.laning: Early on, don’t fully push the wave; keep it in the middle, last-hit cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and poke Lux with Q to stack when she comes into range. Lux Q Light Binding can continue through after hitting one ally, so don’t stand in a line with your teammates. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Lux.phase: In the late game, Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power keeps stacking, which favors Veigar.
Lux.teamfight: From behind your team, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off the enemy’s approach or block their escape. Don’t group up as you approach, or Lux E Lucent Singularity can catch everyone together. If an enemy is trapped or crowd controlled, hit them with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst on a key target who has lost health.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, it’s easy to get hit by her other spells too, so avoid standing in a line with allies and dodge Q. Leave the area marked by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and if a spell hits you and applies Lux P Illumination’s mark, keep your distance to avoid her empowered basic attack. Move sideways when you see the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark.

Malzahar.build: Malzahar Q Call of the Void, W Void Swarm, and E Malefic Visions mainly deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Also consider Mercurial Scimitar or Quicksilver Sash to counter the suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp. Its damage scales with your maximum health, so be wary of choices that add a lot of health alone.
Malzahar.combo: First break Malzahar P Void Shift with Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Then place Veigar E Event Horizon behind Malzahar on his escape route so he has to touch its edge. While he’s stunned, hit him with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst last, after health has been reduced.
Malzahar.escape: The chance to go in comes after you dodge Malzahar Q Call of the Void, Malzahar W Void Swarm’s summons disappear, and Malzahar P Void Shift is down. Malzahar has no spell to create distance on his own, so use Veigar E Event Horizon to block both his approach and escape routes. If Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available, don’t engage alone.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, break it first with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, then block his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon. Dodge the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void and look for a chance to act after Malzahar W Void Swarm’s summons disappear. Veigar has no spell to escape on his own, so don’t force the gap close.
Malzahar.laning: Take a step back from a wave afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions. Keep the wave in the middle and use Veigar Q Baleful Strike to look for cannon minion last hits and hits on Malzahar. If Malzahar pushes the wave and Malzahar P Void Shift is down, look for a chance to catch him with your jungler. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Malzahar.phase: In the late game, Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power keeps stacking, so manage the wave and scale.
Malzahar.teamfight: From behind your team, use Veigar E Event Horizon to block Malzahar’s approach or escape route. If Malzahar W Void Swarm’s summons are already out, clear them first with Veigar Q Baleful Strike or W Dark Matter, then break Malzahar P Void Shift before attacking. If an enemy is trapped or crowd controlled by an ally, hit them with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Use R Primordial Burst on a key target who has lost health.
Malzahar.watch: When a minion afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect jumps to a nearby enemy, so don’t go for a last hit next to that minion. If you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside the gap between the two portals to avoid the silence. When Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available, don’t enter areas without vision alone.

Mel.build: Veigar depends heavily on mana and ability haste, so prioritize those. Mel’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance rather than armor.
Mel.combo: After Mel W Rebuttal is down, place Veigar E Event Horizon behind her on her escape route. Then drop Veigar W Dark Matter where she’s trapped, hit her with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and finish Mel with Veigar R Primordial Burst after she has lost health.
Mel.escape: Go in when Mel E Solar Snare is down and she has also used Mel W Rebuttal. Mel has no mobility, so if you block her escape with Veigar E Event Horizon during that window, it’s hard for her to get out.
Mel.fight: Start attacking after Mel W Rebuttal and Mel E Solar Snare are down. Mel has no mobility, so block her escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and drop Veigar W Dark Matter where she’s trapped.
Mel.laning: When Mel comes into range, watch out for Mel W Rebuttal and hit her with Q to stack. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Mel.phase: Early on, Veigar has few stacks and low survivability, so focus on getting through without falling behind. In the late game, both champions grow strong through stacks, so scale safely with Veigar and deny Mel chances to stack.
Mel.teamfight: From behind your team, use Veigar E Event Horizon to block Mel’s escape or the enemy’s approach. If Mel is trapped or crowd controlled by an ally, hit her with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Save Veigar R Primordial Burst for a key target who has lost health.
Mel.watch: If you’re hit in the center of Mel E Solar Snare, you’ll be rooted and Mel Q Radiant Volley can follow up, so dodge to the side. Don’t throw Veigar Q Baleful Strike while Mel W Rebuttal is active.

Naafiri.build: Build Cloth Armor first to withstand Naafiri's damage, then choose Plated Steelcaps. Move Zhonya's Hourglass earlier in your build to prepare for an engage after Veigar E Event Horizon is down.
Naafiri.combo: When Naafiri’s engage tool is down, place Veigar E Event Horizon across her escape route so she is stunned if she crosses the edge. Then hit her with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and finish Naafiri, who has lost health, with Veigar R Primordial Burst.
Naafiri.escape: Do not engage immediately just because Naafiri E Eviscerate is down. Before Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit comes off cooldown, take the opening when her other mobility tools are also down to block her escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and then engage.
Naafiri.fight: Poke with Veigar Q Baleful Strike from behind the minion wave, but save Veigar E Event Horizon for defense when Naafiri can close in. If the pack reappears right after Naafiri uses Naafiri E Eviscerate, clear it with an area ability such as Veigar Q Baleful Strike or Veigar W Dark Matter, then counterattack.
Naafiri.laning: Early on, keep the lane near the middle instead of fully pushing it, and use Veigar Q Baleful Strike to farm and build poke stacks. If possible, finish off cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and stop poking when your mana drops below half.
Naafiri.phase: In the late game, make use of Veigar's stacking growth and area damage by grouping up with your team for fights.
Naafiri.teamfight: From behind your allies, cut off Naafiri's approach with Veigar E Event Horizon, then follow up with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike when she is trapped or stunned.
Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once, create distance until the bleed ends to avoid the second hit. Pre-place Veigar E Event Horizon across the path Naafiri would use to close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, and avoid moving alone while Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is available.

Orianna.build: Veigar relies heavily on mana and ability haste, so prioritize those. Orianna's main damage is magic damage, so build magic resistance instead of armor.
Orianna.combo: Place Veigar E Event Horizon behind Orianna along her escape route to block the path out across its edge. Veigar W Dark Matter takes time to land, so do not cast it before Veigar E Event Horizon.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no ability that creates distance on its own, so close in when the ball is not nearby and you have avoided the forced movement from Orianna R Command: Shockwave. Once you approach, place Veigar E Event Horizon over Orianna's escape route to block her way out.
Orianna.fight: Right after Orianna Q Command: Attack sends the ball away from her, she lacks the sustained defensive stats from Orianna E Command: Protect, creating an opportunity to trade. At that moment, poke with Veigar Q Baleful Strike and build stacks instead of trading basic attacks with Orianna. If you see a chance to kill her, place Veigar E Event Horizon over her escape route so she crosses its edge.
Orianna.laning: Avoid Orianna P Clockwork Windup's repeated basic attacks, and watch for Orianna R Command: Shockwave when the ball is nearby. When your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Orianna.phase: In the late game, Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power keeps stacking, so managing waves and scaling gives you the advantage.
Orianna.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off the enemy’s approach or block the escape routes of enemies, including Orianna. Avoid the area around Orianna’s ball, and hit trapped targets or targets caught by allied crowd control with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst to finish a key damage dealer who has lost health.
Orianna.watch: Be careful around the area where Orianna Q Command: Attack places the ball, as Orianna W Command: Dissonance slows and Orianna R Command: Shockwave forcibly moves you. Position based on the ball rather than Orianna herself, and move away if it is nearby. Early on, avoid basic-attack fights so you do not get hit repeatedly by attacks empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup.

Ryze.build: Ryze's main damage is magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Also get movement speed so you can walk out of warned areas. If the root from Ryze W Rune Prison after Ryze E Spell Flux marks you is a concern, consider a crowd control cleanse.
Ryze.combo: Place Veigar E Event Horizon behind Ryze along his escape route so he is stunned if he tries to cross its edge. Then drop Veigar W Dark Matter where he is trapped and hit him with Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst last, after Ryze's health has been reduced.
Ryze.escape: If you dodge Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison only slows you, making it easier to approach than when you would be rooted. If Ryze W Rune Prison is also down, block his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and start your combo.
Ryze.fight: When Ryze comes into range, poke with Veigar Q Baleful Strike and build stacks. When Ryze R Realm Warp is down, look for a chance to fight by blocking his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon. Veigar E Event Horizon is also your only defensive tool for stopping an engage, so do not use it for an overextended attack.
Ryze.laning: Finish cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and poke Ryze for stacks when he comes into range. When your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Ryze.phase: Early on, Veigar lacks stacks and Ryze lacks mana and damage, so focus on scaling without taking unfavorable fights. In the late game, Veigar's stacks keep building, so you gain the advantage the longer you manage waves and buy time.
Ryze.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to block Ryze's approach or escape route. Save Veigar R Primordial Burst for a weakened key target, and fight in narrow paths when possible.
Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, the damage from Ryze Q Overload is empowered and spreads to nearby targets, so stay away from your allies until the mark disappears. Ryze W Rune Prison used after the mark roots, so prioritize dodging Ryze E Spell Flux. If you see Ryze R Realm Warp, watch the arrival point; if Veigar E Event Horizon can stun Ryze, interrupt the cast.

Sylas.build: If Sylas is closing in on Veigar, move Zhonya's Hourglass earlier in your build to have a defensive option when Veigar E Event Horizon is down. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Sylas's damage.
Sylas.combo: When Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, place Veigar E Event Horizon behind him to block his escape. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst last, after health has been reduced.
Sylas.escape: Dodge the chains from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct; the window to engage is before that ability comes back up. Sylas W Kingslayer is also a movement tool, so do not go deep just because Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down. Block his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon during the window when both movement tools are down.
Sylas.fight: When Sylas can engage, do not spend Veigar E Event Horizon entirely on offense; keep it ready for his approach. Maintain your distance and hit Sylas with Veigar Q Baleful Strike to build stacks, then fight by blocking his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon after Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down. Account for the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer and do not delay the finish for too long after lowering his health.
Sylas.laning: Keep the lane near the middle instead of fully pushing it, and only step forward when you know where the enemy jungler is. When your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Sylas.phase: Early on, Veigar lacks stacks and has limited ways to survive, so do not force a win. In the mid game, keep building stacks in mid lane unless you have a clear chance to kill; in the late game, fight with your accumulated ability power.
Sylas.teamfight: Stand behind your allies and cut off Sylas's approach with Veigar E Event Horizon. If you trap Sylas right after he dashes in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, you can focus him before he heals with Sylas W Kingslayer. Hit trapped targets or targets caught by crowd control with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and save Veigar R Primordial Burst for a weakened key target.
Sylas.watch: With Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, watch out for the chains that fly after the first dash. If a chain hits you, Sylas pulls himself to you and knocks you up, so dodge in time with the second part. The intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash explodes after a delay, so move away immediately even if the first hit only grazes you.

Syndra.build: Buy boots early so you can walk out of the areas targeted by Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Build magic resistance against Syndra's main magic damage, and get health as well to withstand the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.combo: If Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, place Veigar E Event Horizon over Syndra's escape route so she crosses its edge.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak has a long cooldown and is her only self-defense tool, so the moment it is down is your chance to engage. Veigar has no mobility, so close the distance while dodging the line of Syndra Q Dark Sphere and block her escape with Veigar E Event Horizon.
Syndra.fight: Try to trade after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down and you have moved out of the line of her spheres. Syndra has no mobility, so if you can close the distance, block her escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and hit her with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike.
Syndra.laning: Early on, keep the lane near the middle instead of fully pushing it, finish cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and build stacks. Hit Syndra with Veigar Q Baleful Strike to scale when she comes into range, but stop poking and farm when your mana drops below half.
Syndra.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to block Syndra's escape route or the enemy's approach. Hit trapped or stunned targets with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Avoid areas covered by several Syndra Q Dark Sphere orbs because of Syndra R Unleashed Power, and use Veigar R Primordial Burst to finish a weakened enemy damage dealer.
Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere is between Veigar and Syndra, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can knock the sphere into you and stun you, so move out of its line. Move away from areas covered by several Syndra Q Dark Sphere orbs as the threat from Syndra R Unleashed Power is also greater there.

Talon.build: Early on, withstand Talon's physical damage with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. If Talon is closing in on Veigar, move Zhonya's Hourglass earlier in your core build to have a defensive option after Veigar E Event Horizon is down. If your damage is not getting through because of Talon's high magic resistance, get penetration with Void Staff.
Talon.combo: When Talon's engage tool is down or you can block his escape route, place Veigar E Event Horizon behind Talon so he has to cross its edge to get out. Then drop Veigar W Dark Matter where he is trapped and hit him with Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Veigar R Primordial Burst becomes stronger based on his missing health, so use it last.
Talon.escape: Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is your chance to catch him with Veigar E Event Horizon. If you confirm he has also used Talon R Shadow Assault, look for a counterattack window when he cannot escape with stealth.
Talon.fight: Early on, do not accept Talon's strong trades; poke from a safe distance with Veigar Q Baleful Strike and build stacks. Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, look for a chance to block his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and counterattack. Keep in mind that using Veigar E Event Horizon offensively leaves you with fewer ways to stop his next engage.
Talon.laning: Normally, keep the lane near the middle and finish cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike or build stacks during safe opportunities to poke. If Talon roams, share his location and keep vision on the jungle routes. When your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Talon.phase: In the late game, Veigar's stacks keep building while Talon's influence declines, so prioritize scaling and wave management over risky chases.
Talon.teamfight: Stand behind your allies and place Veigar E Event Horizon across Talon's path into the backline, then group with your allies to layer crowd control. Hit Talon with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike when he is trapped or unable to move. Save Veigar R Primordial Burst for an important target whose health has been reduced, and fight in narrow paths when possible.
Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake hits you, getting hit by the returning blades makes Talon P Blade's End's follow-up dangerous, so move out of their return path after the first hit. Watch for the dash from Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and Talon E Assassin's Path, and save Veigar E Event Horizon for his approach. When Talon R Shadow Assault is available, he can escape with stealth, so do not chase recklessly.

TwistedFate.build: Veigar relies heavily on mana and ability haste, so prioritize purchases that provide them. To withstand Twisted Fate’s damage, build magic resistance over armor.
TwistedFate.combo: Place Veigar E Event Horizon across Twisted Fate’s escape route to pressure him into stepping on its edge. If he is stunned or trapped with little room to move, drop Veigar W Dark Matter and hit him with Veigar Q Baleful Strike. After health has been reduced, finish with Veigar R Primordial Burst.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is your chance to approach.
TwistedFate.fight: While Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is still available, keep your distance and use Veigar Q Baleful Strike to poke while building stacks. After he uses the gold card, place Veigar E Event Horizon behind him to block his escape and fight. Veigar E Event Horizon is your only survival tool, so if there’s a risk the opponent will engage, save it to block their path instead of using it offensively.
TwistedFate.laning: When Twisted Fate comes within range, hit him with Veigar Q Baleful Strike to build stacks. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and farm.
TwistedFate.phase: In the late game, Veigar gains an advantage as his stacks keep building, so manage the waves and keep scaling.
TwistedFate.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to block Twisted Fate’s approach or escape route. If Twisted Fate R Destiny is visible and he is in range, stun him on the edge of Veigar E Event Horizon to stop his movement. If an enemy is trapped or hit by allied crowd control, land Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and use Veigar R Primordial Burst on a key target whose health has been reduced.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate is holding a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay out of range. Reduce the poke from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards by standing behind minions.

Vex.build: Veigar relies heavily on mana and ability haste, so prioritize those first. Build magic resistance over armor to withstand Vex’s damage. Also consider movement speed to dodge her telegraphed areas.
Vex.combo: Place Veigar E Event Horizon behind Vex’s escape route to make her step on its edge. Then drop Veigar W Dark Matter and hit her with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, finishing Vex with Veigar R Primordial Burst after her health has been reduced.
Vex.escape: Your chance to engage is when Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear has been used on the wave or for poke, and Vex W Personal Space’s shield is down.
Vex.fight: Early on, build stacks by hitting Vex with Veigar Q Baleful Strike instead of forcing fights. When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear has been used and Vex W Personal Space’s shield is down, block her escape with Veigar E Event Horizon and fight.
Vex.laning: Keep the lane near the middle instead of fully pushing, and use Veigar Q Baleful Strike to farm and poke. Last-hit cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and stop poking if your mana drops below half. Only move forward when you know where the enemy jungler is.
Vex.phase: In the late game, Veigar gains an advantage as Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power stacks build up.
Vex.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off Vex’s approach, then hit a trapped or stunned opponent with Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. If an ally is hit by Vex R Shadow Surge, create a chance to catch Vex together as she dashes toward your allies. Save Veigar R Primordial Burst to finish a key opponent whose health has been reduced.
Vex.watch: Don’t force an approach while Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear is ready. Vex E Looming Darkness covers a larger area from farther away, so dodge it with a short sidestep. If you are hit by Vex R Shadow Surge, move toward your allies and place Veigar E Event Horizon in Vex’s path as she dashes in.

Viktor.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor to account for the damage from Viktor Q Siphon Power, Viktor E Hextech Ray, and Viktor R Arcane Storm. Movement speed is also useful for walking out of Viktor W Gravity Field and Viktor R Arcane Storm.
Viktor.combo: Place Veigar E Event Horizon across Viktor’s escape route so he has to step on its edge to leave. When he is stunned, drop Veigar W Dark Matter first because it has a travel time, then follow with Veigar Q Baleful Strike.
Viktor.escape: Your chance to approach comes when Viktor W Gravity Field is down or you are outside its area. Viktor has no dash to escape on his own, so close the distance and block his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon.
Viktor.fight: Early on, don’t force an approach. Sidestep Viktor E Hextech Ray while using Veigar Q Baleful Strike to poke and build stacks. After leaving Viktor W Gravity Field, place Veigar E Event Horizon on Viktor’s escape route to create a chance to close the distance. Account for the shield and movement speed from Viktor Q Siphon Power, and focus your damage when Viktor is trapped or stunned.
Viktor.laning: Keep the lane near the middle instead of fully pushing, and build stacks by last-hitting cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike. When Viktor clears the wave, avoid standing in line with the minions to dodge Viktor E Hextech Ray’s poke. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming. Only move forward when you know where the enemy jungler is.
Viktor.phase: In the late game, both champions grow stronger with permanent stacks, so reassess trades when the glow on Viktor’s staff changes color.
Viktor.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to block Viktor’s escape or cut off an opponent’s approach. If Viktor is trapped or hit by allied crowd control, land Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and use Veigar R Primordial Burst when you need to kill Viktor after his health has been reduced. Fight in narrow passages, but don’t stay inside Viktor W Gravity Field.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don’t stand in line with the wave; sidestep it. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave immediately instead of continuing to trade inside it, and avoid the stun. Viktor controls the battlefield more as he gets closer, so watch your distance when he gains a shield and movement speed from Viktor Q Siphon Power.

Vladimir.build: Vladimir’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If his healing prolongs fights, get healing reduction next. Liandry’s Torment is also effective when Vladimir builds health, as it deals damage based on maximum health.
Vladimir.combo: Bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first, then place Veigar E Event Horizon behind his escape route when it ends. After health has been reduced, finish with Veigar R Primordial Burst.
Vladimir.escape: After Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, you have a chance to catch him with Veigar E Event Horizon. If he has also used Vladimir E Tides of Blood, you can engage while avoiding its slow. If you have already used Veigar E Event Horizon, your survival options are limited, so don’t force an engage.
Vladimir.fight: Bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first, then block his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon as it ends. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst as a finisher after the opponent’s health has been reduced.
Vladimir.laning: Early on, manage the lane near the middle without fully pushing. Last-hit minions and poke Vladimir with Veigar Q Baleful Strike. If possible, kill cannon minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike to build stacks. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming. Only move forward when you know where the enemy jungler is.
Vladimir.phase: Veigar gains an advantage as his stacks build, so focus on scaling toward the late game.
Vladimir.teamfight: Stand behind your allies and use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off Vladimir’s approach or block his escape. Spread out so several allies aren’t hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague at once, and if you are infected, fight again after the effect ends. Save Veigar R Primordial Burst for a key opponent whose health has been reduced.
Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion heals him and also grants movement speed when empowered, so keep your distance when he approaches. When Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. Vladimir W Sanguine Pool can dodge important abilities, so use Veigar E Event Horizon after the pool ends. If you are hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague, you take increased damage, so retreat until the effect ends.

Xerath.build: The reference doesn’t specify which items to buy first. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance to counter Xerath’s magic damage, but first consider ways to avoid or remove the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb.
Xerath.combo: Place Veigar E Event Horizon across Xerath’s escape route to make him step on its edge.
Xerath.escape: Your chance to engage comes right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. You can also sidestep Xerath Q Arcanopulse while it charges to close the distance. Xerath has no mobility, so once you get close, block his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon.
Xerath.fight: Early on, don’t force an approach. Build stacks by hitting Xerath with Veigar Q Baleful Strike when he comes within range. When Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, close the distance and block his escape with Veigar E Event Horizon.
Xerath.laning: Keep the lane near the middle without fully pushing. Last-hit minions with Veigar Q Baleful Strike and build stacks when Xerath comes within range. Farm while avoiding Xerath’s heavy damage, then push the lane and call your jungler when Xerath runs out of mana. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Xerath.phase: Veigar grows stronger as his stacks build, so he gains an advantage as the game goes late.
Xerath.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off an approach or block Xerath’s escape. If Xerath is trapped or hit by allied crowd control, land Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike, then use Veigar R Primordial Burst on a key target whose health has been reduced. Fight in narrow passages if possible.
Xerath.watch: Be especially careful of Xerath E Shocking Orb, as its stun can set up follow-up attacks. Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging, change direction and sidestep. Dodge immediately when you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.

Yasuo.build: Hold on early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Yasuo’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If someone is targeting Veigar and diving in, move Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier in your build order.
Yasuo.combo: Place Veigar E Event Horizon across Yasuo’s escape route, then drop Veigar W Dark Matter where he is trapped and hit him with Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Veigar R Primordial Burst grows stronger based on missing health, so use it last.
Yasuo.escape: Yasuo’s Q Steel Tempest stacks reset right after he throws his tornado, so look for an opening to engage. If Yasuo R Last Breath isn’t available yet, trap and attack him with Veigar E Event Horizon. Don’t engage just because Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is down.
Yasuo.fight: First break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with Veigar Q Baleful Strike poke, then trade damage. When Yasuo has just used his tornado and temporarily has no way to knock you up, trap and attack him with Veigar E Event Horizon.
Yasuo.laning: Don’t fully push the lane; keep it slightly pulled toward your side to reduce the minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use as stepping stones. Safely build poke stacks with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and last-hit cannon minions with Q as well, but stop poking if your mana drops below half.
Yasuo.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off Yasuo’s approach or block the opponent’s escape. If the opponent is trapped or hit by allied crowd control, land Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike, then use Veigar R Primordial Burst on a key damage dealer whose health has been reduced.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use minions as stepping stones to reach Veigar, so place Veigar E Event Horizon in his path ahead of time. After Yasuo lands Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, his next Q will knock enemies up, so watch the effect and sidestep out of its line.

Zed.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Zed’s main damage is physical and Veigar has low armor, so build armor early. If Zed is diving in to target Veigar, move Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier in your core build order to have a defensive option after Veigar E Event Horizon is down.
Zed.combo: Place Veigar E Event Horizon behind Zed’s escape route rather than beneath him, so he has to step on its edge to leave. Then drop Veigar W Dark Matter where he is trapped and hit him with Veigar Q Baleful Strike, finishing Zed with Veigar R Primordial Burst after his health has been reduced. A good window for this combo is when both Zed W Living Shadow and Zed R Death Mark are down.
Zed.escape: Don’t engage just because Zed W Living Shadow is down. If Zed R Death Mark isn’t ready yet, use Veigar E Event Horizon to block his escape and engage. If Zed dives in first with Zed R Death Mark, interrupt his attack with Veigar E Event Horizon while the mark is active.
Zed.fight: Trade damage when Zed W Living Shadow is down or after Zed has already swapped positions with his shadow. Before then, don’t use all of Veigar E Event Horizon offensively; save it to stop Zed’s engage. If he dives in with Zed R Death Mark, place Veigar E Event Horizon in his path to interrupt his combo.
Zed.laning: Only move forward when you know where the enemy jungler is. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Zed.phase: Zed peaks in the mid game but gets weaker as the game goes late, so avoid getting caught alone in the mid game, group with your allies, and keep scaling for Veigar’s late game.
Zed.teamfight: Stand behind your allies and use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off Zed’s approach. If Zed is trapped or hit by allied crowd control, land Veigar W Dark Matter and Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Save Veigar R Primordial Burst to finish a key damage dealer whose health has been reduced.
Zed.watch: Be careful of trades where Zed uses W Living Shadow to approach, then slows you with Zed E Shadow Slash and hits you with Zed Q Razor Shuriken. Watch the shadow’s position and move outside Zed E Shadow Slash’s range. If he dives in with Zed R Death Mark, use Veigar E Event Horizon before the mark detonates to stop Zed’s follow-up attacks.

Zoe.build: Veigar relies heavily on mana and ability haste, so prioritize those. Against Zoe’s magic damage, build magic resistance rather than armor. However, resistance cannot block the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, so consider health as well, and prioritize movement speed to dodge the sleep.
Zoe.combo: Place Veigar E Event Horizon on Zoe’s escape route or where she started Zoe R Portal Jump, and bait her into touching its edge. After Zoe’s health has been reduced, finish her with Veigar R Primordial Burst.
Zoe.escape: The moment Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down is your chance to go in.
Zoe.fight: Don’t force a kill early. When Zoe comes within range, poke her with Veigar Q Baleful Strike and build stacks. As Zoe casts Zoe Q Paddle Star!, block her path with Veigar E Event Horizon to disrupt her redirect. If she moves with Zoe R Portal Jump, aim for the spot she started from so you can counterattack when she returns.
Zoe.laning: Keep the wave near the middle instead of pushing it all the way, and use Veigar Q Baleful Strike to last-hit cannon minions while also hitting Zoe to build stacks. Only move forward when you know where the enemy jungler is. If your mana drops below half, stop poking and focus on farming.
Zoe.phase: The longer the game goes and the more stacks you build, the more favorable it is for Veigar, so manage the wave in mid unless you have a clear chance to secure a kill.
Zoe.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Veigar E Event Horizon to cut off the enemy’s approach or block Zoe’s escape route. Use Veigar R Primordial Burst to finish off a key damage dealer whose health has been reduced.
Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you’ll fall asleep shortly afterward and can be hit by follow-up attacks, so move behind a wall or an ally as soon as you’re hit. Zoe can redirect Zoe Q Paddle Star! right after casting it, so when you see her winding up, block her path with Veigar E Event Horizon. Even a bubble that misses remains as a trap, so be careful in narrow paths without vision.
